mapper.select: select id,cashback_ratio from course_cashback_config where id=1
select id from course_cashback_config where id=1 for update
mapper.insert: insert into course_cashback_config(id,cashback_ratio,update_time) values(1,#{cashbackRatio},now()) on duplicate key update cashback_ratio=values(cashback_ratio),update_time=now()
mapper.select: select * from course_cashback_ledger where order_no=#{orderNo} limit 1
mapper.update: update course_cashback_ledger set status='REVERSED' where order_no=#{orderNo} and status='ACTIVE'
mapper.select: select l.* from course_cashback_ledger l left join user_info ui on ui.id=l.student_id where and (l.status != 'UNATTRIBUTED' or #{scope.fullAccess}) and l.course_id=#{query.courseId}and l.order_no like concat('%',#{query.orderNo},'%')and (ui.real_name like concat('%',#{query.studentKeyword},'%') or ui.phone like concat('%',#{query.studentKeyword},'%'))and l.employee_user_id=#{query.employeeUserId}and l.owner_dept_id=#{query.ownerDeptId}and l.status=#{query.status}and l.create_time >= #{query.payTimeBegin}and l.create_time <= #{query.payTimeEnd} order by l.create_time desc,l.id desc
select * from course_cashback_ledger where employee_user_id=#{employeeUserId} order by create_time desc,id desc

select coalesce((select sum(gross_cashback) from course_cashback_ledger where employee_user_id=#{employeeUserId} and status='ACTIVE')-(select coalesce(sum(amount),0) from course_cashback_deduction where employee_user_id=#{employeeUserId}),0)

select d.id,d.employee_user_id,d.amount,d.reason,d.operator_user_id,d.create_time from course_cashback_deduction d join course_cashback_ledger l on l.employee_user_id=d.employee_user_id where l.order_no=#{orderNo} order by d.create_time desc
